blocks.name: start
blocks.label: Start
blocks.description: Where the program begins. Everything wired below Start runs, top to bottom, when you press Run.

blocks.name: loop
blocks.label: Loop
blocks.description: Runs the blocks wired to body the given number of times, then carries on from done.
blocks.example: Loop (times 3) with Print "hi" on body prints hi three times; done continues after.

blocks.name: if
blocks.label: If
blocks.description: Checks a condition. Runs the true branch when it holds, otherwise the false branch.
blocks.example: If (condition: count > 5) -> true: Print "big", false: Print "small".

blocks.name: else_if
blocks.label: Else If
blocks.description: Goes on the false branch of an If: another condition, checked only when the ones before it failed.
blocks.example: If x == 1 -> false: Else If x == 2 -> true: Print "two".

blocks.name: else
blocks.label: Else
blocks.description: Goes on the false branch of an If or Else If: its body runs when no condition before it held.
blocks.example: If x > 0 -> false: Else -> body: Print "not positive".

blocks.name: loop_forever
blocks.label: Loop Forever
blocks.description: Repeats its body until the program is stopped. Put a Sleep inside so it doesn't spin flat out.
blocks.example: Loop Forever -> body: Print "tick" -> Sleep 1.0 prints tick every second.

blocks.name: for_loop
blocks.label: For Loop
blocks.description: Counts with a variable: runs body once for each value in the range (0 up to the number, or any Python range such as 1, 11).
blocks.example: For Loop (variable i, range 5) -> body: Print i prints 0 to 4.

blocks.name: print
blocks.label: Print
blocks.description: Writes a line of text on the terminal. Use the [Txt] / [Int] / [Dec] tag to choose whether the value is text or a number.

blocks.name: input
blocks.label: Input
blocks.description: Shows a prompt and waits for the player to type a line. The line comes out of result as text.
blocks.example: Input (prompt "Name: ") -> result into Concat "Hi " + result -> Print.

blocks.name: clear
blocks.label: Clear Screen
blocks.description: Clears the terminal screen.

blocks.name: sleep
blocks.label: Sleep
blocks.description: Waits the given number of seconds (decimals allowed) before the next block runs.

blocks.name: set_redstone
blocks.label: Set Redstone
blocks.description: Sets the redstone signal strength (0-15) the computer sends out of one of its sides. Click the side to cycle it.
blocks.example: Set Redstone (side Back, power 15) lights a lamp behind the computer; power 0 turns it off.

blocks.name: on_key_press
blocks.label: On Key Press
blocks.description: An event: its body runs every time a key is pressed while the program runs. key is the key's name.
blocks.example: On Key Press -> body: Print key prints each key you press.

blocks.name: on_redstone
blocks.label: On Redstone
blocks.description: An event: its body runs when a redstone input to the computer changes. sides holds the input strengths.
blocks.example: On Redstone -> body: Print sides shows the new inputs.

blocks.name: add
blocks.label: Add
blocks.description: Adds two numbers.

blocks.name: subtract
blocks.label: Subtract
blocks.description: Subtracts b from a.

blocks.name: multiply
blocks.label: Multiply
blocks.description: Multiplies two numbers.

blocks.name: divide
blocks.label: Divide
blocks.description: Divides a by b. The result is a decimal number; dividing by 0 stops the program with an error.

blocks.name: modulo
blocks.label: Modulo
blocks.description: The remainder after dividing a by b.
blocks.example: Modulo (a 7, b 3) -> result 1; a % 2 == 0 tests for even numbers.

blocks.name: negate
blocks.label: Negate
blocks.description: Flips the sign of a number.

blocks.name: power
blocks.label: Power
blocks.description: Raises base to the power exp.

blocks.name: equal
blocks.label: Equal (==)
blocks.description: True when a and b are equal. Feed result into an If's condition.

blocks.name: not_equal
blocks.label: Not Equal (!=)
blocks.description: True when a and b differ.
blocks.example: Not Equal (a: Input result, b "quit") -> If keeps going until quit is typed.

blocks.name: greater_than
blocks.label: Greater (>)
blocks.description: True when a is greater than b.
blocks.example: Greater (a: count, b 10) -> If -> true: Print "done".

blocks.name: less_than
blocks.label: Less (<)
blocks.description: True when a is less than b.

blocks.name: greater_equal
blocks.label: Greater/Equal (>=)
blocks.description: True when a is greater than or equal to b.
blocks.example: Greater/Equal (a: score, b 100) -> If -> true: Print "win".

blocks.name: less_equal
blocks.label: Less/Equal (<=)
blocks.description: True when a is less than or equal to b.

blocks.name: to_int
blocks.label: To Int
blocks.description: Turns a value into a whole number (text such as "12", or a decimal, which is cut down).

blocks.name: to_float
blocks.label: To Float
blocks.description: Turns a value into a decimal number.

blocks.name: to_str
blocks.label: To String
blocks.description: Turns a value into text, to join it with other text.
blocks.example: Variable count -> To String -> Concat "Count: " + result.

blocks.name: concat
blocks.label: Concat
blocks.description: Joins two pieces of text into one.

blocks.name: string_constant
blocks.label: String
blocks.description: A fixed piece of text. Wire value into any text input.

blocks.name: number_constant
blocks.label: Number
blocks.description: A fixed number. Wire value into any number input.

blocks.name: set_variable
blocks.label: Set Variable
blocks.description: Stores value under a name, so later blocks (Variable) can read it. Setting it again replaces the old value.
blocks.example: Set Variable (name count, value 0), later Set Variable (name count, value: Add count + 1).

blocks.name: variable
blocks.label: Variable
blocks.description: Reads a value stored with Set Variable (or a For Loop's counter).
blocks.example: Variable i -> Print inside a For Loop.

blocks.name: on_ui_event
blocks.label: When Widget
blocks.description: For GUI apps: its body runs when a widget on your screen is clicked, changed, submitted or selected. value is the widget's new value.
blocks.example: When Widget (widget add, event Clicked) -> body: Set Variable count + 1.

blocks.name: ui_set_text
blocks.label: Set Widget Text
blocks.description: For GUI apps: changes the text a label or button shows.
blocks.example: Set Widget Text (widget count, text: Concat "Count: " + count).

blocks.name: ui_get_value
blocks.label: Read Widget
blocks.description: For GUI apps: reads a widget's current value (a text field's text, a slider's number, a checkbox's state).

blocks.name: ui_set_enabled
blocks.label: Enable Widget
blocks.description: For GUI apps: makes a widget usable (Yes) or greyed out (No).
blocks.example: Enable Widget (widget send, enabled No) while a message is sent.

blocks.name: ui_set_checked
blocks.label: Check Widget
blocks.description: For GUI apps: ticks (Yes) or clears (No) a checkbox or toggle.

blocks.name: ui_set_value
blocks.label: Set Slider
blocks.description: For GUI apps: moves a slider to a number.

blocks.name: ui_notify
blocks.label: Notify
blocks.description: For GUI apps: shows a notification on the desktop (needs the notifications permission, added when you package).

blocks.name: ui_quit
blocks.label: Close App
blocks.description: For GUI apps: closes the app.
blocks.example: When Widget (widget quit, Clicked) -> body: Close App.
